title: Peer/deliver and Peer/receipt: accountId never validated
description:
Both peer handlers deserialize accountId from the wire but never compare it against the server's own account (a-self). RFC 8620 §5.1 requires returning accountNotFound for any invalid accountId. A peer sending the wrong accountId is silently accepted.

Fix: after deserializing args, check account_id == "a-self"; return JmapError::account_not_found() otherwise. Same pattern as owner handlers fixed in loop 1.
